scope: Synthetic loopback HTTP/HTTPS tests and CLI subprocesses. No external service, production token or cloud deployment.
tls_test_keys: Fresh disposable certificates in OS temporary storage; no keys in release files.
limitations: No penetration test or security certification
No production receiver or durable-storage test
No real credentials or remote uploads
No exactly-once delivery, rollback or automatic POST retry
Timeout is per socket operation, not a total batch deadline
